newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys Mar diesel, jet cargoes from Total.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys Mar diesel, jet cargoes from Total.

text.p: Sri lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded a tender to buy gas oil and kerosene for delivery to Trincomalee and Colombo to French refiner Total SA, a company source said on Monday.

CPC awarded 65,000 barrels each of 1.0 percent and 0.5 percent gas oil and 15,000 barrels of illuminating kerosene was awarded at $2.20 per barrel over spot Singapore quotes on a cost-and-freight Trincomalee (c-and-f) basis, northeast of Sri Lanka.
It also awarded 220,000 barrels of 1.0 percent gas oil and 40,000 barrels of jet A-1 was awarded a 61 cents over spot Singapore quotes on a Colombo c-and-f basis.
Both cargoes are to be delivered on March 1-2.
In its last tender, CPC bought 180,000 barrels of 1.0 percent gas oil and 120,000 barrels of jet A-1 at 58 cents over Singapore spot quotes on a c-and-f Colombo basis.
